description:
## Outcome

The accepted macOS ARM64 package contains correctly signed runtime binaries and passes Apple notarization and trust checks before stable public publication.

## Work

1. Inventory every shipped Mach-O executable and library.
2. Sign nested code in the required order with the approved identity and entitlements.
3. Submit the final distributable form for notarization and retain the result.
4. Verify signatures, notarization, and Gatekeeper behavior on a clean system.
5. Record signing and notarization evidence in provenance.
6. Keep unsigned local development candidates clearly marked.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The package passes signature and notarization checks.
- [ ] A changed nested runtime file fails verification.
- [ ] Signing happens before the external archive checksum.
- [ ] Credentials and certificate material do not enter logs or artifacts.
- [ ] A required trust failure blocks public publication.

## Tests

Run codesign, notarization status, Gatekeeper, tamper, extraction, and packaged-artifact checks.

## Non-goals

Do not sign another target, publish, or update Homebrew.
title: Sign and notarize the macOS ARM64 release artifact
